summary: New agentic workspaces and SDKs are emerging, with a focus on local execution and cost efficiency. Meta is competing on price for coding agents, while Anthropic is exploring shared context and coordinator sessions. DeepSeek is opening up its agent runtime, and IBM is evolving its agent to a development partner. Security remains a concern, with new tools for scanning repositories and discussions around agent oversight. There's also a growing interest in agent SDKs and their potential for vendor lock-in. | Vendor-only roundup: Anthropic Opus 5 and Mistral Studio/Vibe are the biggest product deltas; several infra posts (containment, MCP security, sandboxes) affect agent runtime/security; practical operator guidance from AWS and JetBrains. | GitHub OSS snapshot: vendor releases (Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, GitHub changelog) plus multiple agent infra repos; many repo-only signals need social/vendor corroboration. | Packages snapshot: vendor CLI releases (OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot), Sentry MCP server, rising eval/memory/security toolkits; missing social/operator reports for workflows.
